pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Evening Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Evening Prayer has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Evening Prayer.
   D. Use Evening Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bhagwat Gita? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bhagwat Gita.
   C. Say Bhagwat Gita has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Bhagwat Gita to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

6. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   C. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of Social festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Social festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social festivals.
   C. Say Social festivals has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Evening Prayer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Bhagwat Gita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. D — Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. D — Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Self-awareness; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Evening Prayer; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Bhagwat Gita; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
